WXS shows only BAP1 enriched (q=0.034) with a wide CI; PBRM1 not significant. evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: The set is characterized by upregulation of immune-related pathways (allograft rejection, IL6-JAK-STAT3) and downregulation of metabolic pathways (heme, fatty acid metabolism), consistent with an inflammatory/metabolic shift. BAP1 mutations and CDKN2A loss are known ccRCC alterations, but the wide CI and q>0.05 for CNV gain/loss limit certainty. These findings are exploratory and not sufficient for clinical action.

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: Median silhouettes are near zero across all modalities, indicating weak cluster separation. RNA shows the highest silhouette (0.023) but still low. Patient support counts are moderate (median 3 of 4 modalities positive), but only 21.9% of patients are positive in all estimable modalities. PERMANOVA R2 values are small (<0.04), though RNA has the largest. PERMDISP is significant for WSI (p=0.039) and RNA (p=0.014), suggesting dispersion differences. Internal probe shows very low silhouette and low resampling ARI (0.24), indicating unstable substructure. Boundary to C0002 is weak (pair silhouette 0.00038).
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: The set shows weak but consistent multimodal signal, with RNA contributing most to separation. The low silhouettes and small R2 indicate that the partition is not strongly separated in any single modality. The significant PERMDISP for RNA and WSI suggests heterogeneity within sets rather than clear separation. These structural findings do not independently validate a distinct biological subtype.
limitations: Negative PCoA eigenvalues discarded; PERMDISP approximate.

actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent RNA-defined biological identity with strong pathway effect sizes (e.g., ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION SMD=1.15, IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING SMD=1.11) and very low q-values. WXS shows BAP1 enrichment (q=0.034) and CNV shows moderate continuous changes (e.g., chr20q, chr12p, CDKN2A locus) with q<0.05. Technical confounders are not significant, and known-label overlap is minimal. Structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge; the internal probe shows low ARI (0.24) and weak silhouette, indicating no organized substructure. Retaining C0001 as a discovery-stage candidate is better supported than Drop.

C0002 has a coherent RNA-defined biological identity opposite to C0001, with strong pathway effect sizes (e.g., ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION SMD=-1.15, HEME_METABOLISM SMD=1.15) and very low q-values. WXS shows BAP1 depletion (q=0.034) and CNV shows moderate continuous changes (e.g., chr20q, chr12p, CDKN2A locus) with q<0.05. Technical confounders are not significant, and known-label overlap is minimal. Structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge; the internal probe shows higher ARI (0.64) but still low silhouette, and the boundary to C0001 is weak. Retaining C0002 as a discovery-stage candidate is better supported than Drop.
